newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHENS LAUNCHES MOTORIST INFO MESSAGING SYSTEM.
newsitem.headline: ATHENS LAUNCHES MOTORIST INFO MESSAGING SYSTEM.

text.p: A new information system for motorists entering the city of Athens was presented on Wednesday by its mayor Dimitris Avramopoulos.

The Variable Message System (VMS) consists of large signs installed at key entry points to Athens' centre which warn motorists for current city centre traffic conditions and give travel time estimates.
At the early stages of VMS's development, information signs have been installed at five entry points to Athens, including Ilioupoleos, Syngrou, Piraeus, Athinon and Mesogion.
Another five signs will be in place next month, while there are plans for the use of VMS for the broadcast of other information pertaining to quality of urban life, besides traffic conditions.

The system was developed for the Municipality of Athens jointly by the Environment Ministry and the Transportation Infrastructure Department of the Metsovion National Polytechnic. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
